question: What is my roll number and which semester am I in?

question: Which department am I in?
How many courses am I registered for in the current semester?
llm_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS registered_courses
FROM acad.registration r
JOIN acad.course_offering o ON o.offering_id = r.offering_id
JOIN org.academic_session s ON s.session_id = o.session_id
WHERE r.status = 'REGISTERED'
  AND s.is_current = TRUE;

question: What is my CGPA after the last completed semester?
llm_sql:
SELECT sp.cgpa
FROM acad.semester_performance sp
WHERE sp.session_id = (
    SELECT MAX(session_id)
    FROM org.academic_session
    WHERE is_current = FALSE
);

question: Show my grade in every course of my last completed semester, with the course title.
llm_sql: -- UNANSWERABLE

WITH last_sem AS (
    SELECT session_id
    FROM org.academic_session
    WHERE is_current = FALSE
    ORDER BY end_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.title AS course_title, r.grade
FROM acad.result r
JOIN acad.registration reg ON r.registration_id = reg.registration_id
JOIN acad.course_offering co ON reg.offering_id = co.offering_id
JOIN acad.course c ON co.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN last_sem ls ON co.session_id = ls.session_id
ORDER BY c.title;

question: What is the total amount of fees I have successfully paid so far?
llm_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_paid FROM fin.payment WHERE status = 'SUCCESS';

question: In which courses is my attendance below 95 percent this semester? Show the percentage.
llm_sql:
SELECT c.course_code,
       c.title,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ca.status = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS attendance_percent
FROM acad.registration r
JOIN acad.course_offering co ON co.offering_id = r.offering_id
JOIN acad.course c ON c.course_id = co.course_id
JOIN org.academic_session s ON s.session_id = co.session_id
JOIN acad.class_attendance ca ON ca.registration_id = r.registration_id
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
  AND r.status = 'REGISTERED'
GROUP BY c.course_code, c.title
HAVING ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ca.status = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) < 95;

question: How many students are registered in each of the courses I teach this semester?
llm_sql: -- UNANSWERABLE

SELECT c.title AS course_title,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) AS student_count
FROM acad.offering_instructor oi
JOIN acad.course_offering co ON oi.offering_id = co.offering_id
JOIN org.academic_session s ON co.session_id = s.session_id
JOIN acad.registration r ON r.offering_id = co.offering_id
JOIN acad.course c ON co.course_id = c.course_id
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
  AND r.status = 'REGISTERED'
GROUP BY c.title;

question: Who are the 5 students in my department with the highest latest CGPA? Give roll numbers and CGPA.
llm_sql: -- UNANSWERABLE

WITH latest_perf AS (
 SELECT sp.student_id, sp.cgpa,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.student_id ORDER BY s.start_date DESC) AS rn
 FROM acad.semester_performance sp
 JOIN org.academic_session s ON sp.session_id = s.session_id
)
SELECT st.roll_no, lp.cgpa
FROM latest_perf lp
JOIN people.student st ON lp.student_id = st.student_id
WHERE lp.rn = 1
ORDER BY lp.cgpa DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Which students of our department have a medical leave waiting for approval? Show their names.

SELECT p.full_name
FROM acad.medical_leave ml
JOIN people.student s ON ml.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN people.person p ON s.person_id = p.person_id

question: How many students were admitted in 2025 in each programme?
llm_sql:
SELECT p.name AS programme_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS student_count
FROM people.student s
JOIN org.program p ON s.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE s.admission_year = 2025
GROUP BY p.name;

question: What is the total amount of successful fee payments for each academic year?
llm_sql:
SELECT s.acad_year, SUM(p.amount) AS total_successful_payments
FROM fin.payment p
JOIN fin.fee_demand d ON d.demand_id = p.demand_id
JOIN org.academic_session s ON s.session_id = d.session_id
WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS'
GROUP BY s.acad_year;

question: List the roll numbers of CS students admitted in 2024 together with their father's mobile number.
llm_sql:
SELECT s.roll_no, g.mobile_no
FROM people.student s
JOIN org.department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN people.guardian g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science'
  AND s.admission_year = 2024
  AND g.relation = 'FATHER';

question: How many residents does my hall have for each admission year?
llm_sql:
SELECT s.admission_year,
       COUNT(*) AS resident_count
FROM people.student s
WHERE s.hall_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.admission_year
ORDER BY s.admission_year;

question: For each company, how many applications have been shortlisted?
llm_sql:
SELECT c.name AS company_name,
       COUNT(ja.job_application_id) AS shortlisted_applications
FROM cdc.job_application ja
JOIN cdc.job_posting jp ON ja.posting_id = jp.posting_id
JOIN cdc.company c ON jp.company_id = c.company_id
WHERE ja.status = 'SHORTLIST'
GROUP BY c.name;

question: How many students are on roll in each department?
llm_sql:
SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS on_roll_students
FROM people.student s
JOIN org.department d ON s.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE s.current_status = 'ON ROLL'
GROUP BY d.name;

question: Compare my SGPA in each semester with the average SGPA of my whole department for that semester.
llm_sql:
SELECT s.session_id,
       s.acad_year,
       s.term,
       sp.sgpa AS my_sgpa,
       dept_avg.avg_sgpa
FROM acad.semester_performance sp
JOIN org.academic_session s ON sp.session_id = s.session_id
JOIN people.student st ON sp.student_id = st.student_id
JOIN (
    SELECT sp2.session_id,
           st2.department_id,
           AVG(sp2.sgpa) AS avg_sgpa
    FROM acad.semester_performance sp2
    JOIN people.student st2 ON sp2.student_id = st2.student_id
    GROUP BY sp2.session_id, st2.department_id

SELECT s.session_id,
       s.acad_year,
       s.term,
       sp.sgpa AS my_sgpa,
       dept_avg.avg_sgpa
FROM acad.semester_performance sp
JOIN org.academic_session s ON sp.session_id = s.session_id
JOIN people.student st ON sp.student_id = st.student_id
JOIN (
    SELECT sp2.session_id,
           st2.department_id,
           AVG(sp2.sgpa) AS avg_sgpa
    FROM acad.semester_performance sp2
    JOIN people.student st2 ON sp2.student_id = st2.student_id
    GROUP BY sp2.session_id, st2.department_id
) dept_avg ON sp.session_id = dept_avg.session_id
          AND st.department_id = dept_avg.department_id;

question: List my current advisees whose latest CGPA is below 7.0, with roll number and CGPA.
llm_sql:
SELECT s.roll_no,
       sp.cgpa
FROM people.faculty_advisor fa
JOIN org.academic_session cur_sess ON cur_sess.is_current = TRUE
JOIN people.student s ON s.student_id = fa.student_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sp.cgpa
    FROM acad.semester_performance sp
    WHERE sp.student_id = s.student_id
    ORDER BY sp.session_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) sp ON TRUE
WHERE fa.employee_id = CURRENT_USER -- row‑level security provides current employee
  AND fa.from_session_id <= cur_sess.session_id
  AND (fa.to_session_id IS NULL OR fa.to_session_id >= cur_sess.session_id)
  AND sp.cgpa < 7.0;

question: For every course of my department offered this semester, show the instructor's name and how many of my department's students are registered.
llm_sql: -- UNANSWERABLE

SELECT c.course_code,
       c.title,
       e.display_name AS instructor_name,
       COUNT(r.registration_id) AS student_count
FROM acad.course c
JOIN acad.course_offering co ON co.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN org.academic_session s ON s.session_id = co.session_id
                         AND s.is_current
JOIN acad.offering_instructor oi ON oi.offering_id = co.offering_id
JOIN people.employee e ON e.employee_id = oi.employee_id
LEFT JOIN acad.registration r ON r.offering_id = co.offering_id
                              AND r.status = 'REGISTERED'
LEFT JOIN people.student stu ON stu.student_id = r.student_id
                             AND stu.department_id = c.department_id
GROUP BY c.course_code, c.title, e.display_name
ORDER BY c.course_code;

question: Which students in my department have both an overdue fee demand and a failing grade?
llm_sql:
SELECT s.roll_no, p.full_name
FROM people.student s
JOIN people.person p ON s.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lib.library_due d
    WHERE d.person_id = s.person_id
      AND d.status = 'UNPAID'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM acad.result r
    JOIN acad.registration reg ON r.registration_id = reg.registration_id
    WHERE reg.student_id = s.student_id
      AND r.grade IN ('D','F')
);

question: How many students have an overdue fee demand above 70000 and a declared family income below 500000?
llm_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.student_id) AS student_count
FROM fin.fee_demand fd
JOIN fin.family_income_declaration fid ON fid.student_id = fd.student_id
WHERE fd.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND fd.total_amount > 70000
  AND fid.annual_income < 500000;

question: For how many fee demands was there a failed payment followed later by a successful one?
llm_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p_fail.demand_id) AS demand_count
FROM fin.payment p_fail
WHERE p_fail.status = 'FAILED'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM fin.payment p_succ
    WHERE p_succ.demand_id = p_fail.demand_id
      AND p_succ.status = 'SUCCESS'
      AND p_succ.paid_at > p_fail.paid_at
  );

question: Among CS students, list the 10 biggest drops in CGPA between their last two semesters, with roll number, previous CGPA, latest CGPA and the drop.
llm_sql:
WITH perf AS (
    SELECT
        sp.student_id,
        s.start_date,
        sp.cgpa,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.student_id ORDER BY s.start_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM acad.semester_performance sp
    JOIN org.academic_session s ON sp.session_id = s.session_id
), paired AS (
    SELECT
        p1.student_id,
        p2.cgpa AS previous_cgpa,
        p1.cgpa AS latest_cgpa,
        (p2.cgpa - p1.cgpa) AS drop_amount
    FROM perf p1
    JOIN perf p2 ON p1.student_id = p2.student_id
               AND p1.rn = 1
               AND p2.rn = 2
)
SELECT
    st.roll_no,
    paired.previous_cgpa,
    paired.latest_cgpa,
    paired.drop_amount
FROM paired
JOIN people.student st ON paired.student_id = st.student_id
JOIN org.department d ON st.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science'
ORDER BY paired.drop_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: For companies with more than 90 job applications, what percentage of their applicants received an offer?
llm_sql:
SELECT c.name,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(o.offer_id)::numeric / COUNT(ja.job_application_id), 2) AS offer_percentage
FROM cdc.company c
JOIN cdc.job_posting jp ON jp.company_id = c.company_id
JOIN cdc.job_application ja ON ja.posting_id = jp.posting_id
LEFT JOIN cdc.offer o ON o.job_application_id = ja.job_application_id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING COUNT(ja.job_application_id) > 90;

question: Which department has the highest average latest CGPA among students currently on roll?
llm_sql:
SELECT d.name
FROM org.department d
JOIN people.student s ON s.department_id = d.department_id
JOIN (
    SELECT sp.student_id, sp.cgpa
    FROM acad.semester_performance sp
    JOIN (
        SELECT student_id, MAX(session_id) AS max_session
        FROM acad.semester_performance
        GROUP BY student_id
    ) latest ON sp.student_id = latest.student_id AND sp.session_id = latest.max_session
) latest_cgpa ON latest_cgpa.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE s.current_status = 'ON ROLL'
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY AVG(latest_cgpa.cgpa) DESC
LIMIT 1;
